scope: Exact existing-surface evidence fallback: the preserved source inventory contains 30 official-survey operation entries, exactly matching the immutable count. Shared executable bindings for the same provider method/path are merged into one normalized endpoint. The cited official html_reference artifact is retained as the v2 provenance root; no operation was inferred from a documentation crawl. Prior source-surface scope: Pass B full-surface expansion: every endpoint documented in the Customerly Apiary API blueprint (customerlypublic.docs.apiary.io) is accounted for below, XOR'd between covered_by (streams/writes this bundle now implements) and excluded (with a real closed-vocabulary category+reason). Knowledge-base content management (collections/articles/writers) is a distinct product surface (help-center authoring, not contact/CRM data) and is excluded out_of_scope. The previously-invented '/v1/conversations', '/v1/attributes', '/v1/events' entries did not correspond to any documented endpoint in the public blueprint and have been removed rather than carried forward as fictional surface.

operation.reason: ENGINE_GAP: response body is {"data": ["tag1", "tag2", ...]} -- a bare JSON array of scalar strings, not objects; connsdk.RecordsAt only keeps array elements that decode as a JSON object, so a scalar-valued array silently yields zero records, and records.keyed_object explodes an object's VALUES (which must themselves be objects), not a flat array of strings. No declarative primitive fans a bare scalar array into one record per element (same gap class as ip2whois's nameservers deviation, docs/migration/conventions.md ledger item 12); see docs.md Known limits
operation.notes: named_dependency=engine.direct_read_executor: the direct-read executor has no non-redacting output policy for this provider operation
